description: Translate a document into another language while keeping its layout, tables, images and formulas. Takes .docx, .pdf, .pptx, .xlsx, .epub, .html and .txt. Saves the result next to the source and returns its path. COSTS CREDITS at 100 per 1,000 words processed (10 minimum) - say so and get agreement first.

output_path.description: Where to write the result; defaults to beside the source

source_lang.description: Source language, or auto to detect it (the default)

target_lang.description: Target language: zh, en, zh-tw, ja, ko, es, fr, pt, ru, de, pl or it

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait before returning a job id (default 55)

name: translate_document
title: Translate a document
